# Running muxt check before the first muxt generate reports route templates
# as waiting for generated handlers, not as unused, and does not flag the
# partials those routes reference. block actions count as references too:
# text/template/parse compiles {{block "name" .}} into a define plus an
# in-place template invocation, so the footer below is pending, not unused.

! muxt check
cmpenv stderr want-err.txt

-- want-err.txt --
Route templates with no generated handler; run muxt generate to wire them up:
  - $WORK/template.gohtml:1:29: "GET / Home(ctx)"
Error: fail: 1 error
-- template.gohtml --
{{define "GET / Home(ctx)"}}
{{template "greeting" .}}
{{block "footer" .}}bye{{end}}
{{end}}

{{define "greeting"}}Hello{{end}}
-- go.mod --
module server

go 1.24
-- template.go --
package server

import (
	"context"
	"embed"
	"html/template"
)

//go:embed *.gohtml
var templatesFS embed.FS

var templates = template.Must(template.ParseFS(templatesFS, "*"))

type T struct{}

func (T) Home(_ context.Context) string { return "" }
